title: "U-2 at testing site before attachment of wings and tail assembly" (Chapter 2, p. 48)
description: Black-and-white photograph of a U-2 fuselage hanging in a hangar from chain hoists, with its round engine intake/turbine face visible in the foreground. Captioned "U-2 at testing site before attachment of wings and tail assembly." The page text that follows covers the development of the U-2 camera system.
